note: One look for a list or a screen with nothing in it yet (decision element-roles-and-reuse; the UX audit found four)

component.doc: What a list or a screen shows while it has nothing yet: a tinted icon, a short title, one sentence on why it is empty or when it fills, then its children (usually one core://Button that adds the first thing or opens where it comes from), centred in a card whose corners follow the theme's scale (corner_m). Bookmarks before the first save, a week that fills in on Saturday, a deck already swiped through. Show it in a core://Conditional on a count of the list, or as a list's neighbour.

params.name: title
params.doc: What is missing, in a few words (bindings allowed).

params.name: text
params.doc: One sentence: why it's empty, when it fills, or what to do (left out while empty).

params.name: icon
params.doc: An icon name or path:<svg path>.

params.name: tone
params.doc: The icon's tone: accent, success, error or muted.

params.name: corner
params.doc: Corner radius in dp; 0 for the theme's corner_m (14 unless the pod set it).

args.title: Next week fills in Saturday morning
args.text: Your agent pulls in the calendar, workouts and meal ideas overnight.

examples.note: a screen that fills on a schedule
